verdict.rationale: vLLM's CLI reference documents a command that starts the vLLM OpenAI-compatible API server (vllm-docs-27). The official Docker image (vllm-docs-26) is another way to launch the server, so the start half of the story is clearly delivered from the command line. missing for 10: explicit documentation of stopping or managing the server lifecycle from the CLI, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI workflow.
